decisions.reason: As a sound-enhanced version of the firm's traditional candle arch, it still fits the core handcrafted seasonal range well, though normal assortment renewal now makes withdrawal somewhat more plausible than at launch.

This one-tier Christmas pyramid is very close to the firm's longstanding core offer and is the kind of classic seasonal product a traditional craft firm is likely to retain if it has remained saleable for several years.

As an accessory linked to the electronic music-box concept that was already scaled back, it has the weakest strategic fit and is the most sensible candidate to remove in order to free resources for the established wooden décor business.

A Dresden-themed Christmas pyramid builds directly on the firm's traditional strengths and should remain attractive as a premium, distinctive seasonal item, even if themed variants are occasionally rotated.
